subject.title: Named profiles migrate approval state from the default profile

question: Should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102883 be the canonical security-boundary fix for this issue, or should maintainers request a narrower approval-migration-only patch?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but approval-state migration semantics decide how to preserve a shipped migration contract without crossing named-profile isolation.

options.title: Review and land linked fix
options.body: Use the open PR as the canonical fix after maintainer security and compatibility review confirms it preserves bare state-dir relocation behavior.

options.title: Request narrower fix
options.body: Ask for an approval-migration-only PR if the broader Crestodian changes should not share the same landing path.

recommendation.title: Review and land linked fix
recommendation.body: Use the open PR as the canonical fix after maintainer security and compatibility review confirms it preserves bare state-dir relocation behavior.
